# Zenara Designs

> Web design and development agency based in Markham, Ontario, serving the Greater Toronto Area. We build modern, fast, secure, conversion-focused websites for small businesses and professionals — renovation companies and trades, clinics, accounting firms, law firms, and more.

## About

- Name: Zenara Designs
- Type: Web design & development agency (service-area business, no physical storefront)
- Service area: Markham (home base), Stouffville, Scarborough, Toronto, Mississauga, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Pickering
- Email: info@zenaradesigns.com
- Phone: (647) 835-1077
- Website: https://zenaradesigns.com

## Pricing

- Starter: $999 (1–3 pages, 3–5 days)
- Small Business: $1,999 (up to 6 pages, 1–2 weeks)
- Pro: $4,999+ (advanced functionality, unlimited pages, 3–4 weeks)
- All plans include mobile-responsive design, SEO optimization, and SSL security.
- Details: https://zenaradesigns.com/pricing
